'''Dovrin''' was a [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] who led a group of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|If it's death yer playing at, Dovrin's ready to oblige!|Dovrin|<ref name="Legacy 37" />}}
In [[137 ABY]], the [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Dovrin led a group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] that hijacked an [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] shipping vessel in the [[5709-DC Shipping Lane]]. Dorvin's intentions were to acquire new [[M-40 light repeating blaster|Thunderbolt Mark 7 blasters]] that the ship was transporting. In arguing with a [[C-series protocol droid]], the pirate captain shot the droid with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and threatened the life of Captain [[Piard]]. After hearing a noise in the background, Dovrin sent some crew&mdash;consisting of a [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]], a [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]], and a [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]]&mdash;to investigate, only to find that they had been knocked out and replaced by [[Cade Skywalker]], [[Jariah Syn]], and [[Deliah Blue]]. Upon seeing them, Dovrin shot at Cade but it was deflected by Cade's green [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]; the reflected bolt fatally struck Dovrin in the chest.<ref name="Legacy 37" />
